routes.name: Residence Permit for Non-Nationals (Biometric Residence Permit)

note: Sierra Leone, read on 2026-10-31 in two Sierraloaded reports quoting the Sierra Leone Immigration Department (secondary; slid.gov.sl answered 403 to this research client then; read again 2026-11-03): the Chief Immigration Officer's letter of 2 March 2023 to staff and the public, by which every application for a Residence Permit for Non-Nationals must carry a copy of the applicant's Non-National ID card, and the Department's circular of May 2026 instructing airlines that departing non-national residents show a valid Biometric Residence Permit (or else a valid visa). On 2026-11-03 the Department's own site answered: its FAQ sends applications for permits and residency to the Government's Unified Permit portal, which offers a Residence Permit and a separate Work Permit, with no kinds, fee or term on the pages read (its price is given by a script tool, not run). One `general` route is written: the permit is named without its kinds. No fee (ECOWAS or other), term, renewal, place of application or work right is given; the National Revenue Authority's 'Immigration charges' pages answer only on a mirror host whose certificate has expired, which isn't bypassed.

sources.title: Sierraloaded, 2 March 2023: Immigration Boss Issues New Directives For Residence Permit
sources.said: The Chief Immigration Officer (CIO) of the Sierra Leone Immigration Department, Andrew Jaiah Kaikai, has issued a new directive for obtaining residential permit. ... effective today all applications for Residence Permits for Non-Nationals should be attached with copies of their Non-National ID cards.

sources.title: Sierraloaded, 8 May 2026: Sierra Leone Government Withdraws Earlier Directive on Immigration Permit at Airport
sources.said: airlines have been instructed to ensure that non-national residents present a valid Biometric Residence Permit before check-in and boarding. In the absence of this permit, a valid visa must be provided.
